items.title: Show HN: Word42, a wordprocessor inspired by MS Word and Abiword
items.desc: description: Word42 is a classic word processor, written from scratch in C on GTK 4, Pango and Cairo: the shape and restraint of the word processors of 1993 on a modern text stack. Free software, GPL3.0orlater. What it does A working word processor: typing, formatting, styles and numbered headings, headers and footers, footnotes and endnotes, tables, pictures, lists, columns, find and replace, spelling, hyphenation, mail merge, a split window, a pagelayout view and print preview — reading and writing RTF, OpenDocument .odt, Word .docx and .doc, AbiWord .abw, HTML, PDF and plain text. The [user guide](https://github.com/office42/word42/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md)describes every command in the program; the [status page](https://github.com/office42/word42/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md) and [architecture notes](https://github.com/office42/word42/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)tell the rest. Get Word42 Windows [Get it from the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NKG7V7CRX06) Or take the bundle and installer built on every push — artifacts of the [Windows workflow](https://github.com/office42/word42/actions/workflows/windows.yml). macOS An unsigned Word42.app from the [macOS workflow](https://github.com/office42/word42/actions/workflows/macos.yml). First launch is a rightclick ▸ Open. Linux Build from source with Meson — [docs/BUILD.md](https://github.com/office42/word42/blob/main/docs/BUILD.md)has the details; a Flatpak manifest is in buildaux/.
items.author: roschdal
items.descZh: Word42 是一款从零开始用 C 语言基于 GTK 4、Pango 和 Cairo 编写的经典文字处理器，以自由软件（GPL 3.0+）形式发布，旨在将 1993 年老式文字处理器的简洁形态与现代文本技术栈相结合。该项目提供了完整的功能集，包括打字、格式化、样式与编号标题、页眉页脚、脚注与尾注、表格、图片、列表、分栏、查找替换、拼写检查、断字、邮件合并、分屏窗口、页面布局视图与打印预览，并支持读写 RTF、OpenDocument、Word DOCX/DOC、AbiWord、HTML、PDF 及纯文本等众多格式。在平台支持方面，Word42 已上架 Microsoft Store，macOS 提供未签名包（需右键打开），Linux 则通过 Meson 从源码构建并附带 Flatpak 清单，所有平台的构建产物均通过 GitHub Actions 自动生成。其最大亮点在于以约 30MB 左右的轻量级二进制实现几乎可与 AbiWord 抗衡的文档格式兼容性，同时忠实复刻了早期字处理器的克制交互美学。适用场景包括：需要本地离线文档编辑的隐私敏感用户、轻量级办公替代方案寻求者，以及希望在现代系统上体验经典写作界面风格的用户。
items.quote: Word42 是一款经典的文字处理器,使用 C 语言基于 GTK 4、Pango 和 Cairo 从零编写而成:兼具 1993 年文字处理器的形态与克制,运行于现代文本环境之上。
items.titleZh: 显示HN：Word42，一个字处理器的灵感来自MS Word和Abiword

(I use it on subway.) So I bu
items.author: xooch_95
items.descZh: 作者在没有 JDK 环境时需要完成多种 Java 相关的开发调试工作，包括浏览 JAR 包内文件、反编译 .class 文件、编辑 YAML/Properties/JSON 等配置文件、导出修改后的 JAR、查看类结构与字节码等，且希望能在手机端使用，因此开发了这款工具。它在零 JDK 依赖场景下实现了完整的 JAR 资源管理、类文件反编译与字节码查看，并支持手机端运行，可随时随地处理工作需求，典型场景如地铁通勤时调试 Java 项目。亮点在于无需本地安装 JDK 即可完成从文件浏览、反编译、配置修改到导出 JAR 的全流程，且覆盖移动端，弥补了传统 JDK 工具链对环境的依赖短板。适用于后端开发者在无开发环境的设备上快速定位问题、修改配置或学习类结构，也适合教学演示和应急排障。
items.quote: 所以我把它做成了能在手机上处理所有这些场景，即使在地铁上也能用。

items.title: Show HN: Jetway, a working airline GDS and message router
items.desc: Over the past few days I made an open-source GDS, message router, departure control system, faring engine, and a bunch of other airline systems. It supports Type B/AIRIMP, EDIFACT/PADIS, NDC, MATIP; PNRs, tickets, EMDs, queues, IROPS; PNL/ADL, bags, loadsheets, MVT, ACARS, flight plan
items.author: adam_gyroscope
items.descZh: 背景：作者在数天内构建了一套开源的航空业核心系统套件（GDS、消息路由、离港控制、运价引擎等），填补了航空业长期缺乏开源底层基础设施的空白。核心功能：覆盖旅客服务全链路，包括 PNR、机票、电子杂项单据（EMD）、队列、不正常航班（IROPS）、PNL/ADL 旅客名单、行李、配载单、MVT 航班动态、ACARS 通信与飞行计划等。亮点：兼容多种行业标准协议，如 Type B/AIRIMP、EDIFACT/PADIS、NDC 和 MATIP，单一作者数日内完成这种协议覆盖深度极为罕见，展现了极强的开发效率。适用场景：可作为航空公司、NDC 聚合商、技术供应商快速验证业务流程、二次定制的起点，也适合航空 IT 学习与研究。
items.quote: 过去几天，我做了一个开源的 GDS、消息路由器、离港控制系统、运价引擎，以及一堆其他的航空公司系统。
items.titleZh: Jetway：一个可运行的航空公司 GDS 和消息路由系统

[The Bigger Picture](https://medium.com/?source=post_pagebcb6c7afe4f8cdbf) [](https://medium.com/@mhiritarek?source=post_pagepost_author_sidebarbcb6c7afe4f8a5370a78c540) Tarek Mhiri/ spicesformind.com Empowering Millennials/Gen Z with digital safety tips and life transition insights, ethical hacking with personal [growth.Blog](http://growth.Blog): https://spicesformind.com [Application Security](https://medium.com/tag/applicationsecurity?source=post_pageheader_tagsbcb6c7afe4f8) [Cybersecurity](https://medium.com/tag/cybersecurity?source=post_pageheader_tagsbcb6c7afe4f8) [Software Engineering](https://medium.com/tag/softwareengineering?source=post_pageheader_tagsbcb6c7afe4f8) [Rust](https://medium.com/tag/rust?source=post_pageheader_tagsbcb6c7afe4f8) [Appsec](https://medium.com/tag/appsec?source=post_pageheader_tagsbcb6c7afe4f8) Why I Built a Deterministic CPGtoNuclei Compiler in Rust [](https://medium.com/@mhiritarek?source=post_pagebylinebcb6c7afe4f8) [Tarek Mhiri/ spicesformind.com](https://medium.com/@mhiritarek?source=post_pagebylinebcb6c7afe4f8) 3 min read · 2 days ago [Listen](https://medium.com/m/signin?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmedium.com%2Fplans%3Fdimension%3Dpost_audio_button%26postId%3Dbcb6c7afe4f8&operation=register&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fmedium.com%2F%40mhiritarek%2Fwhyibuiltadeterministiccpgtonucleicompilerinrustbcb6c7afe4f8&source=header_actionsbcb6c7afe4f8post_audio_button) Share Press enter or click to view image in full size []() My background is in mechanical engineering. When I transitioned into cybersecurity, I brought a physical mindset with me: a system only works when the right forces are applied to the right mechanisms. Today, the tech industry tends to treat AI like a magic wand. I see it differently. Large Language Models are a brilliant new technological commodity — much like electricity. You don’t ask electricity to build a car; you use it to power the machines that do. You treat it with respect, implement security boundaries, and remember the golden rule of engineering: use the right tool for the right job. When you apply this to automated security testing and agentic workflows, the current approach is fundamentally broken. We are asking language models to do precision machining. Agents get stuck in trialanderror loops — guessing payload syntaxes, hitting CLI flag errors, and hallucinating schema parameters. It burns massive amounts of execution credits. Even worse, when an agent finally produces a functional template, it often causes statemutation friction. It modifies application settings or pollutes enterprise databases without cleaning up, forcing maintainers to reject the pull requests to protect production environments. To solve this, I decided to build the machine that the AI should plug into. I built and opensourced cpgnucleicompiler (v1.0.0): a Rustnative compiler that converts Code Property Graphs (CPGs) into syntactically perfect ProjectDiscovery Nuclei YAML templates, backed by an isolated Docker execution harness. Source (C/C++, Java, Go, Python) ──► Joern CPG ──► DataFlowSlice ──► Nuclei YAML ──► Docker Harness (TP/TN) The 3Tier Hybrid Model: Rather than forcing an LLM to guess lowlevel exploit structures, this pipeline decouples highlevel intent from exact code generation: · The Intent (AI Layer): Highlevel reasoning maps target objectives. The AI acts as the electricity, deciding what to look for without wrestling with YAML formatting. · The Machine (Rust Engine): The core compiler parses Joern CPG schemas and Single Static Assignment (SSA) dataflow paths. It computes taint graphs natively in Rust, generating 0%error Nuclei YAML templates in milliseconds with minimal memory overhead. · The Quality Control (Docker): The generated template runs inside an isolated container fixture to produce verifiable True Positive (TP) and True Negative (TN) reachability proofs before a pull request is ever submitted. RealWorld Proof: Solving Issue 11635 (PR 17007) To validate this approach on a live target, I refactored the template for CVE2024–51483
items.author: Tarek-M
items.descZh: 作者具有机械工程背景，转向网络安全后将工程思维应用于 AI 与自动化安全工作，认为当前让大语言模型直接生成 Nuclei 安全测试模板的方式存在精度低、产生脏数据等问题。为此他用 Rust 开发并开源了 cpgnucleicompiler（v1.0.0），将源代码经 Joern 生成 CPG，再经数据流切片，最终由 Rust 编译器输出语法完美的 Nuclei YAML 模板，并通过隔离 Docker 容器验证 TP/TN。该系统采用三层混合架构：AI 负责高层意图决策，Rust 引擎解析 SSA 数据流与污染路径，可在毫秒级生成零错误的 YAML 并保持极低内存占用，Docker 沙箱则提供可验证的可达性证明。作为案例，该方案重构了 CVE-2024-51483 的模板并解决了 Issue 11635（PR 17007）。该项目面向应用安全研究人员、DevSecOps 团队以及红队/渗透测试工程师，尤其适合需要将静态分析结果自动转化为可审计、可复现漏洞模板的场景。
items.quote: 你不会让电力来造汽车，而是用它来驱动造车的机器。

See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Photosynthesis: 2…" "twitter:title": "Photosynthesis: 2Lens Camera App App Store" Search [Today](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/today) [Games](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/games) [Apps](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/apps) [Arcade](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/arcade) Platform [iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/today) [iPad](https://apps.apple.com/us/ipad/today) [Mac](https://apps.apple.com/us/mac/discover) [Vision](https://apps.apple.com/us/vision/appsandgames) [Watch](https://apps.apple.com/us/watch/appsandgames) [TV](https://apps.apple.com/us/tv/discover) Photosynthesis: 2Lens Camera Use 100% of your camera Only for iPhone Free · In‑App Purchases Share [Age Rating4+Years](information) [CategoryPhoto & Video](information) [DeveloperSam Shepherd](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/samshepherd/id1883556970?platform=iphone) [LanguageEN+ 11 More](information) [Size132.8MB](information) iPhone Photosynthesis captures up to 5x the detail of a subject vs a standard 1x camera, taking photos from two lenses simultaneously and combining them, with no generative AI. Nearly every iPhone has more than one lens on the back, so why not use them? With Photosynthesis, you can use 100% of your camera to bring your memories into sharper focus. When you take a photo, Photosynthesis fires two lenses at once, then combines the results into one extraordinary photo, delivering real optical detail with no generative AI. The app matches the alignment and color of each lens to create a single cohesive image. TAKE BETTER PHOTOS ON NEARLY EVERY IPHONE Photosynthesis delivers the clearest view of your subject without losing the atmosphere, dramatically improving image quality whether you're taking a longdistance shot, or your subject is only an arm's length away. For 'Pro' iPhones with a zoom lens (3 lenses on the back), Photosynthesis pairs the standard 1x lens with the telephoto zoom to give an amazing upgrade in subject detail, whether that's a singer on stage, a landmark, or the face of a loved one. Every iPhone with 2+ rear lenses can pair the standard 1x lens with the ultra wide 0.5x lens to add wider context without compromising on detail, perfect for capturing the atmosphere of a live event or a group shot. iPhones with 3 lenses can also take photos that combine all 3 lenses at once (feature currently in beta). POWERFUL CAPTURE SETTINGS As well as flash and timer controls, you can switch lens pairing and control capture mode from the minimalist capture screen. • SPEED mode captures multiple images at the same instant. • QUALITY mode captures multiple images at once, then takes another photo from each lens separately. The final photo is then built to give the most detail possible. • Both modes also work in low light with Photosynthesis's Night mode. There is also an optional grid and level overlaid on the viewfinder. A CUSTOM EDITOR BUILT FOR TWOLENS PHOTOS The inapp editor provides everything you would expect, including: • Filters pretuned for a variety of different looks • Manual adjustments, which you can save to make your own filters • Crop, rotate, flip and straighten your images • Nondestructive editing your original is never overwritten The editor also contains powerful features designed for the unique twolens photos: • Align: tweak the relative alignment of the lenses by hand • Edit: add a filter or manual adjustments to each lens separately • Reveal: 'paint' over any visual artifacts to reveal the wider lens EXPORT IN A WIDE RANGE OF IMAGE FORMATS Photosynthesis can export photos automatically to the Photos app, as well as backup to a custom folder of your choice, and supports a wide range of export formats: • Finished image: HEIC, PNG and JPEG • Layered: Photoshop (PSD) document with one layer per lens • 3D: Apple Spatial photo, and sidebyside 3D (full or half screen) • The 'Photosynthesis' file — export and reimport without losing any layers or editing capabilities Photosynthesis is entirely free and unlimited for two weeks after you first open the app. After this two week period, you can either unlock Photosynthesis Unlimited to keep the same full experience, offered as both a onetime purchase and a subscription, or keep using the app for free with reduced export and customization options. Photosynthesis works on every iPhone with two or more rear lenses from the iPhone 11 onwards. iPhones with 2 lenses on the back can only use the 1 + 0.5x lens pairing, while iPhones with 3 lenses on the back can choose between 1 + Zoom, 1 + 0.5x and All 3 (beta). Photosynthesis subscriptions are subject to Apple's 'LICENSED APPLICATION END USER LICENSE AGREEMENT' which can be read here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internetservices/itunes/dev/stdeula/ more Events … [CHALLENGE <h3Use 100% of Your Camera</h3 Take your first ever twolens photo of your favourite landscape, or your favourite person Use 100% of Your Camera](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/photosynthesis2lenscamera/id6780102370?eventid=6801674944) Ratings & Reviews This app hasn’t received enough ratings or reviews to display an overview. items.author: sajomes
items.descZh: Photosynthesis 是一款由独立开发者 Sam Shepherd 推出的 iPhone 摄影 App，核心思路是利用多数 iPhone 配备的多颗后置镜头同时拍摄并合成单张照片，以获得超越单镜头 1x 拍摄的细节表现，官方宣称可达 5 倍细节提升，且全程不依赖生成式 AI。Pro 版三镜头机型可将 1x 与长焦镜头配对以远距离拍人像或地标，双镜头机型则可用 1x+0.5x 超广角保留场景氛围，并支持 SPEED、QUALITY 两种双摄拍摄模式以及夜景模式。它还内置专为双镜头图像设计的编辑器，允许用户手动微调镜头对齐、分别对每颗镜头应用滤镜或拉直，以及用"Reveal"画笔修复伪影；导出格式则覆盖 HEIC、PNG、JPEG、PSD 分层文件、Apple Spatial 立体照片以及可再编辑的 Photosynthesis 工程文件。商业上提供两周免费完整试用，之后可买断或订阅解锁全部功能，免费版则限制导出与自定义选项。整体而言，这款 App 适合希望从硬件层面榨取 iPhone 影像潜力、追求真实光学细节而非 AI 后期补足的专业或进阶摄影爱好者。

items.descZh: 该工具由开发者 franzenzenhofer 开源，针对 Chrome 浏览器长期缺少"批量删除已保存标签组"这一痛点，通过直接读写 Chrome 用户配置目录下的 LevelDB 数据库绕过 UI 限制。其核心功能包括 list（按 allprofiles 列出全部配置）、delete（支持 claude / orphans / match <pattern> 等过滤方式，可设 dryrun 预览）、restore（从 ~/.chrometabgroupcleaner/backups/ 回滚备份）以及 synctombstone 写入墓碑记录防止同步复活，支持 Chrome、Chromium、Brave、Edge 等 Chromium 内核浏览器。产品亮点在于零运行时依赖（仅 Node 20+，runtime 依赖数 = 1）、提供 before.png 对比的真实案例数据（71 个已保存标签组中 70 个为 Claude AI 会话遗留）、并以 Claude Code skill 形式分发，可通过自然语言指令"get rid of all these Claude tab groups"触发。最关键的工程细节是执行删除前必须完全退出浏览器，否则 LevelDB 文件被锁且运行中的浏览器会从内存回写覆盖修改，这既是安全护栏也是用户必须知情的操作约束。

This sequential reignition chain ensures that the Lawson Criterion is comprehensively satisfied even within a decentralized environment. Yet, during this continuous chain ignition, vaporized lithium introduces a critical risk of poisoning the core plasma packets and disrupting overall system stability. [](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/1554d4df8b9c788d82c2a8d920345b3f3b7de14e2716ce70d28eb11de9dfb388/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f696e7374616c6c2d6e6f6e652532302543322542372532306f6e6525323048544d4c25323066696c652d73756363657373) [](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/6e6aa9e03378dad90cae1b7e09ae5f7423490f759521e5d459721ecfc52a6fd3/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f746172676574732d436c61756465253230436f6465253230254332254237253230436f6465782d626c7565) [](https://github.com/codedaptive/mootx01ce) [](/bobcodedaptive/fleetgenerator/blob/main/LICENSE) A browser wizard that generates a working agent fleet for Claude Code or Codex. One HTML file, no install, no build step. Open it, answer some questions, download a zip. Now with [MOOTx01](https://github.com/codedaptive/mootx01ce) integration:an optional persistentmemory layer so a session can hand its own work to the next one. The output is a .claude/ directory containing agent definitions, skills, hooks, settings, and an install script. Drop it in a repository and the agents are there next time you start a session. Why a fleet rather than one agent A single agent doing everything is the default, and it is the expensive way. It holds the whole task in one context, reasons about all of it at the top tier, and types every line itself. A fleet splits that into three roles: an orchestrator decomposes the work and dispatches it workers implement one unit each, from a brief a reviewer judges the orchestrator's output before it lands The split is not organisational tidiness. It is what makes the work cheaper and better at the same time: the units run on a smaller model, they run in parallel, and nothing merges without something that did not write it having looked. The orchestrator writing the code itself is the failure of that job, not a shortcut to it. Measured across live runs, orchestrators that dispatched their implementation work ran about 64% of tokens in subagents. Orchestrators that typed it themselves ran 0 to 32%, and cost three to four times as much for comparable work. What you get Agents Role definitions with tools, model, and skills, in the shape your target reads Skills The doctrine each role loads on demand, rather than carrying always Hooks Shell hooks for scope enforcement, push gating, and logging Commands Slash commands for the workflows you picked Settings settings.json wired to the hooks Install script Puts it all in place Getting started Open web/fleetgenerator.html in a browser. Nothing is uploaded; the whole thing runs locally. web/GUIDE.html walks the wizard end to end, including three install paths depending on how much you want to decide up front. sample_out/holds a full generated bundle if you would rather read the output before running anything. Two choices worth understanding before you generate Target Claude Code reads a .claude/ directory. Codex reads an AGENTS.md at the repository root. The doctrine is identical either way, so this is a packaging choice rather than a different fleet. Picking Both emits both entry points from one source, and the AGENTS.md states that the skill files are authoritative. Two descriptions of one fleet drift the moment either is edited, and saying which one wins is cheaper than reconciling them later. Model tiers The generated fleet does not put every agent on one model. Role Tier Why Reviewer top One pass over a finished diff. Cheap, and the only thing between a plausiblelooking change and your main branch. Orchestrator top Pays for itself _if_ it dispatches. If it types the code itself, this is the most expensive possible arrangement. Workers mid They receive a brief containing everything they need, so capability buys less here than anywhere else. items.title: Show HN: We replaced the pelican benchmark with a hippo
items.desc: description: Why our local LLM SVG benchmark switched from a pelican on a bicycle to a hippo on a pogo stick. A small change to our very serious benchmark We retired the pelican. Long live the hippo. Our SVG test now asks models for a hippo on a pogo stick—not a pelican on a bicycle. We’ve been testing local open models. Then we heard a rumor: some models may have seen the pelican prompt before. We don’t know if that’s true. That uncertainty is exactly the problem. 01 / THE PROBLEM The benchmark was benchmarked. A benchmark everyone has seen is a benchmark a model might have seen, too. Pelicanonabike is charming, compact, and surprisingly revealing—but familiarity can masquerade as capability. So we changed the nouns, kept the difficulty, and made the test weird again. “Same coordination problem. New animal. Less benchmark leakage.”— our entire methodology, basically 02 / SIDEBYSIDE Pelican vs. hippo Reserved for outputs from the latest local openmodel runs. Same renderer, same scoring rubric, fresh prompt. ModelOld promptNew prompt Qwenlocal · candidate 01next run P SVG output placeholderpelican + bicycle awaiting run H SVG output placeholderhippo + pogo stick awaiting run DeepSeeklocal · candidate 02 P SVG output placeholderpelican + bicycle awaiting run H SVG output placeholderhippo + pogo stick awaiting run Llamalocal · candidate 03 P SVG output placeholderpelican + bicycle awaiting run H SVG output placeholderhippo + pogo stick awaiting run Mistrallocal · candidate 04 P SVG output placeholderpelican + bicycle awaiting run H SVG output placeholderhippo + pogo stick awaiting run 03 / WHAT STAYS CONSTANT New mascot. Same test. We still score the things that make SVG generation useful—not whether the animal looks cute in a screenshot. 1. 01Valid, editable SVG 2. 02Prompt adherence 3. 03Object relationships 4. 04Visual coherence THE NEW CONTROL PROMPT v2.0 “Create an SVG of a hippo riding a pogo stick.” ↗ Copy it. Try it. Send us the weird ones.

items.descZh: 该文章介绍了本地大语言模型 SVG 生成评测基准的调整：由于"骑自行车的鹈鹕"这一经典测试用例可能在训练数据中被广泛使用，存在数据泄漏风险，导致模型表现虚高。为了更准确地衡量模型的真实 SVG 生成能力，作者将测试主题从鹈鹕换成河马、运动工具从自行车换成弹簧单高跷，新主题同样具备复杂的结构协调难度，但降低了被预先训练覆盖的概率。评测维度保持不变，包括 SVG 语法有效性、提示词遵循度、物体关系处理和视觉连贯性四项核心指标，覆盖 Qwen、DeepSeek、Llama、Mistral 等本地开源模型。作者希望社区用新提示词自行测试并分享结果，以更公平地评估模型的几何推理和结构化输出能力。
